name: AGI-WorkSpace
sloganZh: 知识写进仓库，人和 Agent 共用一份上下文
sloganEn: Knowledge lives in the repo. People and agents read the same source.
introZh: AGI-WorkSpace 是面向研发项目的工作空间模版：Vue 只提供阅读、编辑和写回的壳，项目事实按七个角色写在 Markdown 里。换项目时改文档，不要为每一篇再做一个页面。
introEn: AGI-WorkSpace is a project workspace template: Vue is only the shell for reading, editing, and writing back. Project facts live in Markdown, split by seven roles. Swap the docs for your project — do not add a Vue page per document.
